summary: A production-shaped Phase 2 UI integration package now covers the branded login, locked design contract, authenticated application shell, and dashboard states. Direct application to the private source repository remains blocked by access.
verification: The local package verifier passed 24 assertions across 11 required files.
The packaged logo and shield-ribbon asset hashes match the approved signup sources exactly.
The Supabase password-auth boundary remains present and the package does not change database or middleware behavior.
Ready, loading, empty, and error states remain independently reviewable and sample values are labeled.
Desktop and responsive Chrome renders were visually inspected with no overflow or incomplete entrance states.
No source repository, deployment, authentication account, or external communication was changed.
assumptions: The existing application continues to use the standard Supabase password sign-in method and dashboard route described in the development handoff.
risks: The developer must confirm the Supabase export shape, redirect behavior, middleware contract, and stylesheet merge against the current private repository.
Direct integration cannot be verified until the currently authenticated GitHub account has explicit repository access.
